ops.title: Register crates.io trusted publishers via the HTTP API with a cargo-login token — no browser needed; UA header required; token can't self-revoke
ops.body:
crates.io trusted-publishing (GitHub) configs are manageable via the frontend's JSON API using the `cargo login` token in the `Authorization` header — no browser session needed:

- `GET /api/v1/trusted_publishing/github_configs?crate=<name>` lists configs.
- `POST /api/v1/trusted_publishing/github_configs` with body `{"github_config": {"crate", "repository_owner", "repository_name", "workflow_filename", "environment"}}` creates one.
- Requests **must** send a real `User-Agent`; without one crates.io returns a misleading "API data access policy" 4xx.
- `DELETE /api/v1/tokens/current` fails with "does not have the required permissions" for cargo-login tokens — server-side revocation stays a manual crates.io/me step; `cargo logout` only clears disk.

Used 2026-07-18 to register publishers for spawnllm + spawnllm-core (repo yasyf/spawnllm, workflow release-crates.yml, environment crates-io) after a browser-agent lane died. Related: [[spawnllm-v040-ecosystem]].
